AtlasHXM: Core Services & Value Proposition 
AtlasHXM enables companies to hire, onboard, manage, and pay employees in 160+ countries without the need to establish local legal entities first. It does this through a direct employer of record model, owning and operating its own legal entities globally rather than relying on third-party partners.  
Primary Capabilities & Service Areas 
Global Employment Infrastructure: Acts as the legal employer of record on behalf of clients, handling employment contracts, payroll, labor tax registration, statutory benefits, and documentation across 160+ countries.  
Onboarding & Payroll Management: Provides localized onboarding, payroll execution, benefits administration, and country-specific compliance oversight.  
Human Experience Management (HXM) Platform: Combines technology with human support to deliver consistent experiences for employees worldwide, integrating HR workflows such as payroll, benefits, immigration, and compliance under one platform.  
Global Mobility & Support: Helps with visa processing, work permits, relocation logistics, and ongoing HR support in multiple languages and time zones.  
Benefits & Employee Experience: Offers competitive, locally compliant benefits packages and learning/development resources to support employee engagement and retention across regions.  
Strategic Advantages 
Direct EOR Model: Because Atlas owns its legal entities in 160+ countries, clients benefit from faster onboarding, stronger compliance control, and direct accountability.  
People-First Philosophy: The HXM approach emphasizes not just operational execution but the quality of the employee experience — making global employment more intuitive and human-centric.  
Unified Platform + Local Expertise: Combines a single platform for global workforce operations with localized HR experts providing white-glove support across languages and time zones.  
Faster Time to Market: Enables onboarding often within weeks instead of months, removing the need for costly entity setup.  
Positioning  AtlasHXM positions itself as a comprehensive global workforce partner that blends technology, human expertise, and owned global infrastructure to make international growth operationally manageable and human-centered — facilitating global hiring without the administrative and compliance burden of establishing legal entities. 
AtlasHXM Services & Value Proposition (Web-Verified Summary)

Atlas combines this with a Human Experience Management (HXM) platform that provides unified global HR capabilities, including employee data, onboarding tools, payroll processing, benefits, reporting, and local HR support, designed to improve both operational control and employee experience.  
Because Atlas owns its legal entities directly, clients benefit from consistent service delivery, faster onboarding timelines, and clearer compliance oversight compared with solutions that rely on third-party intermediaries.  
Atlas also offers localized HR expertise, support in multiple languages, and employee-centric features to boost engagement and retention across regions.

Atlas combines this with a Human Experience Management (HXM) platform that provides unified global HR capabilities, including employee data, onboarding tools, payroll processing, benefits, reporting, and local HR support, designed to improve both operational control and employee experience.  
Because Atlas owns its legal entities directly, clients benefit from consistent service delivery, faster onboarding timelines, and clearer compliance oversight compared with solutions that rely on third-party intermediaries.  
Atlas also offers localized HR expertise, support in multiple languages, and employee-centric features to boost engagement and retention across regions.

Atlas combines this with a Human Experience Management (HXM) platform that provides unified global HR capabilities, including employee data, onboarding tools, payroll processing, benefits, reporting, and local HR support, designed to improve both operational control and employee experience.  
Because Atlas owns its legal entities directly, clients benefit from consistent service delivery, faster onboarding timelines, and clearer compliance oversight compared with solutions that rely on third-party intermediaries.  
Atlas also offers localized HR expertise, support in multiple languages, and employee-centric features to boost engagement and retention across regions.

Atlas combines this with a Human Experience Management (HXM) platform that provides unified global HR capabilities, including employee data, onboarding tools, payroll processing, benefits, reporting, and local HR support, designed to improve both operational control and employee experience.  
Because Atlas owns its legal entities directly, clients benefit from consistent service delivery, faster onboarding timelines, and clearer compliance oversight compared with solutions that rely on third-party intermediaries.  
Atlas also offers localized HR expertise, support in multiple languages, and employee-centric features to boost engagement and retention across regions.

Atlas combines this with a Human Experience Management (HXM) platform that provides unified global HR capabilities, including employee data, onboarding tools, payroll processing, benefits, reporting, and local HR support, designed to improve both operational control and employee experience.  
Because Atlas owns its legal entities directly, clients benefit from consistent service delivery, faster onboarding timelines, and clearer compliance oversight compared with solutions that rely on third-party intermediaries.  
Atlas also offers localized HR expertise, support in multiple languages, and employee-centric features to boost engagement and retention across regions.
